name: soft_constraint5.k
model:
class RealSoftConstraints {
  temperature:Real
  pressure:Real

  req temperature >= -2.7315E2

  req temperature <= 1E3

  req pressure >= 0E0

  req pressure <= 1E2

  soft req temperature >= 2E1

  soft req temperature <= 2.5E1

  soft req pressure >= 1E0

  soft req pressure <= 1.1E0

  soft req temperature * pressure < 3E1
}

sensor:RealSoftConstraints
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (sensor Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((RealSoftConstraints (mk-RealSoftConstraints (temperature Real)(pressure Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-RealSoftConstraints (sel-RealSoftConstraints RealSoftConstraints))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-RealSoftConstraints ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-RealSoftConstraints (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-RealSoftConstraints ((this Ref)) RealSoftConstraints
  (sel-RealSoftConstraints (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-RealSoftConstraints ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-RealSoftConstraints this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.sensor: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!sensor ((this Ref)) Ref
  (sensor (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class RealSoftConstraints:
; ------------------------------------------

; --- getters for RealSoftConstraints.temperature: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints!temperature ((this Ref)) Real
  (temperature (deref-RealSoftConstraints this))
)

; --- getters for RealSoftConstraints.pressure: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints!pressure ((this Ref)) Real
  (pressure (deref-RealSoftConstraints this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-RealSoftConstraints (TopLevelDeclarations!sensor this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; --------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class RealSoftConstraints:
; --------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-RealSoftConstraints RealSoftConstraints)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (RealSoftConstraints!temperature this) (- 273.1500000000000000))
)

(assert (! (RealSoftConstraints.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (RealSoftConstraints!temperature this) 1000.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (RealSoftConstraints.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (RealSoftConstraints!pressure this) 0.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (RealSoftConstraints.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (RealSoftConstraints!pressure this) 100.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (RealSoftConstraints.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Soft Constraint 5: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.soft5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (RealSoftConstraints!temperature this) 20.0000000000000000)
)

(assert-soft (RealSoftConstraints.soft5 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft5)

; --- Soft Constraint 6: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.soft6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (RealSoftConstraints!temperature this) 25.0000000000000000)
)

(assert-soft (RealSoftConstraints.soft6 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft6)

; --- Soft Constraint 7: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.soft7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (RealSoftConstraints!pressure this) 1.0000000000000000)
)

(assert-soft (RealSoftConstraints.soft7 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft7)

; --- Soft Constraint 8: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.soft8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (RealSoftConstraints!pressure this) 1.1000000000000000)
)

(assert-soft (RealSoftConstraints.soft8 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft8)

; --- Soft Constraint 9: ---

(define-fun RealSoftConstraints.soft9 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (* (RealSoftConstraints!temperature this) (RealSoftConstraints!pressure this)) 30.0000000000000000)
)

(assert-soft (RealSoftConstraints.soft9 1) :weight 1 :id _xksoft9)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-RealSoftConstraints const-1-RealSoftConstraints))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-RealSoftConstraints () RealSoftConstraints
  (mk-RealSoftConstraints 0.0 43.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (temperature (sel-RealSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 1000.0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (pressure (sel-RealSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 0.0))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (sensor (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-RealSoftConstraints a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (temperature (sel-RealSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) (- (/ 5463.0 20.0))))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (pressure (sel-RealSoftConstraints (select heap 1))) 100.0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-RealSoftConstraints (mk-RealSoftConstraints 0.0 43.0))))
